plugins.description: ISTQB CTFL v4.0.1-grounded manual QA team in your pocket — test case authoring for the Kensa TMS. Multi-engine: runs on Claude Code, replicates as a native Codex plugin, or runs hybrid (Claude delegates QA packages to Codex). test-lead-agent + qa-engineer-agent + strategist, twelve slash commands, 31 skills (21 ISTQB-grounded + 10 plugin tooling), bundled sequential-thinking MCP, cross-platform Stop hooks for auto memory checkpoint and per-session debug log. Interactive installer (install.sh / install.ps1).
